name: briefings
description: Read pre-generated CNN and HN daily briefings.

commands.description: Show both CNN and HN briefings for today (zero tokens — just dumps the file)
Show CNN briefing for a date (default: today)
Show HN briefing for a date (default: today)

prompt_doc: Daily news briefings via `python3 integrations/briefings/cli.py <cmd>`. Commands: `today` (both CNN + HN), `cnn [date]`, `hn [date]`, `list [N]`. These are pre-generated markdown files — just read and send, no analysis needed. If the user asks about a specific story or wants to discuss something from the briefing, read the briefing first via CLI then answer.
